student.en: "There!" At A's shout the net flew from B's arms...
student.ja: 「それツ！」といふＡの懸声もろともに、Ｂの腕からは網が投げられる……。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Looks like one went in!"
student.ja: 「入つたらしいぞ！」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Tch!"
student.ja: 「チエツ！」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: They jumped back into the water, crying "Oh, deep, deep!" and stamping their feet and thrashing their arms like figures in a picture of men bewitched by a fox.
student.ja: 彼等は再び水の中へ躍り込むと、
student.label: house-checked

student.ja: 「おゝ、深え〳〵！」など云ひながら、狐に化された図のやうな格構で脚をふまへ腕を躍らせた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Thrash them in every which way!" Taki ordered.
student.ja: 「滅茶苦茶に叩き込め！」と滝が命令する。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: A and B themselves looked like leaping fish. Spray like a fountain came pattering like rain on the leaves of the pondweed at the water's edge.
student.ja: ＡとＢが、躍り上がつた魚のやうにも見える。噴水のやうなしぶきが雨のやうにパラパラと汀の河骨の葉を打つた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Playing in the water on a hot day!" A muttered, abashed.
student.ja: 「暑い時の水遊びだ！」とＡが、テレたやうに呟いた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Yikes! Something brushed past my calf going by, ugh, creepy!" B said, rubbing his chest.
student.ja: 「キヤツ！　ふくらツぱぎをこすツて行きやあがつた、えゝツ気味が悪い！」とＢが胸をさすつた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "All out attack!" A shouted, and with a whoop the two closed in on the mouth of the trap.
student.ja: 「総攻撃！」とＡが叫んで、二人はワツとばかりに追ひ込みの口へ詰め寄つた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Ah, what fun, what fun." Taki clapped his hands, his mouth wide open.
student.ja: 「あゝ、面白え〳〵。」と滝は、大口をあいて手を打つた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: When evening came the two came up beside Taki and, scratching their heads, said, "At this rate, well..."
student.ja: 夕暮になると、二人は滝の傍に来て、
student.label: house-checked

student.ja: 「この分ぢや、どうも――」
student.label: house-checked

student.ja: さう云つて頭をかいた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Oh, take your time over it. From tomorrow let's lay off the rough stuff and think it over somehow. It would be silly to damage such fine things."
student.ja: 「何アに、ゆつくりやつて貰はうよ、明日からあまり手荒なことは控へて、何とか考へ直さうぢやないか――折角の代物を痛めてしまふのも馬鹿〳〵しいからね。」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Still, it's taking nothing but days..."
student.ja: 「どうも、日ばかりかゝつて――」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "You need not stand on ceremony about that. Once we catch them to our satisfaction there is nothing to worry about. I have made up my mind to sell the lot, not one left."
student.ja: 「そんな遠慮はいらないよ。満足につかまへさへすれば、心配はないんだ、一匹残らず売つてしまふことに肚を決めた。」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "Won't we lose face with the people at the other house?"
student.ja: 「あつし達の面目がつぶれやしないでせうかね、あちらのお宅の方へ？」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: "I'm the master, here, here — that other house and all that..." Taki said, dropping his voice for no reason. "Look, that pretty girl who poured for us, Pin-ko — she said she likes me! She said. I've been thinking about her all day today. It's awkward going alone, so come with me, won't you? Even if we go three or four times more, if we sell the lot there'll still be plenty left over, won't there?"
student.ja: 「僕ア、主だよ、こゝの、こゝの、あつちのことなんて……おいツ！」と滝は、何となく声を落して「あのね、綺麗なお酌がゐたらう、ぴん子といふ――彼女がね、僕のことを好きだ！　と云つたぜ。僕ア、今日、一ン日彼女のことを考へてしまつた。ひとりで行くのは気まりが悪いからさ、つき合はねえか、未だ三度や四度行つたつて、みんな売るとすれば、それならまだ余ツ程あまるねえ？」
student.label: house-checked

student.en: As he said this, Taki began working out the figures closely to himself.
student.ja: そんなことを云ひながら滝は、精細な胸算用を始めた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: IV
student.ja: 四
student.label: house-checked

student.en: When night came the frogs grew loud around the pond, and insects began to be heard.
student.ja: 夜になると池のまはりには蛙の声が高くなり、虫の音などもするやうになつた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: New creditors of all sorts had come visiting the house among the mandarin trees above the stone steps.
student.ja: 石段の上の蜜柑の樹に取り巻かれた家を、新たに、いろ〳〵な種類の債権者が訪れてゐた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: Between them, A and B had borrowed a hand pump from a villa they frequented, and it was settled that they would dry up the pond in one burst.
student.ja: ＡとＢでは、出入の別荘から手おしポンプをかりて来て、一気呵勢に池の水を干してしまはうといふ相談が一決した。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: Taki watched the face of the abacus the old man was clicking.
student.ja: 滝は、年寄が弾く算盤の面を眺めてゐた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: The 'trip' waited only on the 'in one—' work in Taki's study.
student.ja: 「旅」が、滝の書斎での「一気――な」仕事だけを待つた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: Cloudy days in the middle of the dog days went on. Word came round that the waves had begun to rise.
student.ja: 土用半ばの曇り日が続いてゐた。波が立ち始めたといふ噂が伝へられた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: About the pond it was like the uproar at a fire. Beginning with the old man, the collector from the motor shop, the bill-collector from the cook-shop, the 'horse' from the brothel, the keeper of the restaurant, the head clerk of the sake shop, the 'cashier' of the assignation house — each stripped to the waist, they worked the handles of the hand-pump to a common cry under A's direction. Not one wasted a word, and all, short of breath, were bent on the work before their eyes. Up and down, down and up, the cries that burst from them unbidden with all the strength of their bodies held the same underlying force as the chorus of Nancy Lee, and were full of spirit.
student.ja: 池のまはりは、火事場のやうな騒ぎであつた。年寄りを初め、自動車屋の集金人、料理屋の掛け取り、女郎屋の「馬」、レストランの亭主、酒屋の番頭、待合の「お帳場」――それ等の人々が、各々双肌脱ぎになつてＡの指揮にもとづきながら懸声そろへてポンプのハンドルをあをつてゐた。無駄口一つ叩く者がなく一同は息を切つて眼前の仕事に没頭してゐた。上げては降し、降しては上げる満身の力と共に思はずほとばしる彼等の懸声には恰もナンシー・リーのコーラスのやうな底力が籠り、颯爽の気に満ちてゐた。
student.label: house-checked

student.en: The muddy water spurting from the mouth of the pipe that B held braced toward the roof blew tiny gnats in midair, broke brightly and came down as rain grazing the eaves.
student.ja: 家根に向けてＢが支へてゐる筒口からほとばしる泥水は、中空に小さな虻をふき、さんさんと砕けて雨になつて軒先をかすめた。
